```{r}
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "lubridate","arules"))

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(arules)

```


```{r}
load("datasets/malaria_2016.RData")
malaria_2016 <- data

load("datasets/malaria_2017.RData")
malaria_2017 <- data

load("datasets/malaria_2018.RData")
malaria_2018 <- data

load("datasets/malaria_2019.RData")
malaria_2019 <- data

ls()

```
```{r}
#junção de dts
malaria <- bind_rows(
  malaria_2016,
  malaria_2017,
  malaria_2018,
  malaria_2019
)
```
```{r}
glimpse(malaria)
```

```{r}
#filtragem cols usadas
malaria <- malaria %>%
  select(
    exam.interval,
    treatment.interval,
    notification.interval,
    notification.month,
    notification.year,
    migration,
    autochthonous.case,
    exam.result,
    detection.type,
    exam.type,
    symptom,
    hemiparasite,
    previous.treatment,
    occupation,
    education.level,
    age,
    race,
    gender
  )
```

```{r}
# Convertendo todas as colunas para fatores
malaria <- malaria %>% mutate_all(as.factor)
```


```{r}
# Convertendo o dataframe para um objeto de transações
transacoes_malaria <- as(malaria, "transactions")
summary(transacoes_malaria)
```

```{r}
# Criando a interface unificada fit()
fit_mineracao <- function(transacoes, algoritmo = "apriori", min_sup = 0.01, min_conf = 0.8, min_len = 3, max_len = 4) {
  
    # O artigo define confiança de 80% e tamanhos mínimo 3 e máximo 4
    regras <- apriori(transacoes, 
                      parameter = list(supp = min_sup, conf = min_conf, 
                                       minlen = min_len, maxlen = max_len, target = "rules"))
    return(regras)
    
}
```


```{r}
regras_apriori <- fit_mineracao(transacoes_malaria, algoritmo = "apriori")
```
